public_rationale: Independent November testing put Gemini 3 Pro ahead of GPT-5.1 overall and first on five of ten evaluations across several capabilities. That supports Marcus's qualified claim of an apparent benchmark lead. It does not establish universal superiority or a commercial lead.
limitations: The result uses the ordinary model-generation reading of GPT-5, including GPT-5.1.
Benchmark selection and inference settings affect comparisons.
Google's leaderboard statement is corroboration, not independent replication.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Google, with Gemini 3, appears to have overtaken OpenAI in the last month, beating GPT-5 on many benchmarks.

statement.excerpt: But worse than that, from OpenAI’s perspective, Google seems in the last month to have overtaken them, with Gemini 3, which by many benchmarks is better than GPT-5.
statement.document_title: Three years on, ChatGPT still isn't what it was cracked up to be – and it probably never will be

from_speaker: by many benchmarks is better than GPT-5
our_interpretation: Read 'overtaken' as an apparent lead in measured model capabilities, not commercial success or superiority on every task.
Read 'many benchmarks' as several established evaluations spanning different capabilities.
Use November 1–29, 2025, following the surrounding discussion of November.
Read GPT-5 as the model generation, including the contemporaneous GPT-5.1 comparator. The evidence does not establish every possible comparison with the original GPT-5 configurations.
criteria.support_condition: November results show Gemini 3 leading the contemporaneous GPT-5 generation across several established benchmarks and a broad capability comparison.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable November results show no broad Gemini 3 lead and advantages confined to isolated benchmarks.
